column1: # Cogmind 首批教程与属性说明，直接依据英文翻译。
When the line of fire is red, you are attempting to shoot through an object at another target, which incurs significant penalties.
column2: 射击线变红，表示弹道需穿过障碍才能命中目标，这会带来严重惩罚。

column1: When attempting to attach a part directly from the ground, if there is no auto-replacement effect you can quickly repeat the command a second time to attempt a manual swap.
column2: 直接装配地面部件时，若未自动替换，可快速重复同一指令，尝试手动替换。

column1: Right-click on a listed part, or a part, robot, or self on the map to get information.
column2: 右键点击列表中的部件，或地图上的部件、机器人及自身，可查看信息。

column1: Right-click on available options for more info. Keyboard players can use Shift-a~z.
column2: 右键点击选项可查看详情。键盘操作可用Shift-a~z。

column1: Press '.', 'keypad 5' or scroll the mouse wheel to wait a turn.
column2: 按'.'、小键盘5或滚动鼠标滚轮，可等待一回合。

column1: Press '3' to manually label all known items. The number next to each name is its rating. Higher ratings are better.
column2: 按'3'标注所有已知物品。名称旁的数字为评级，越高越好。

column1: Pressing F3 toggles ASCII mode. Be the Cogmind! (Don't worry, everything will be labeled.)
column2: 按F3切换ASCII模式。成为Cogmind吧！别担心，物体都有标签。

column1: Use the buttons at the bottom right of the parts list, or press c/e/w/q, to visualize various stats related to parts and inventory items.
column2: 点击部件栏右下角按钮，或按c/e/w/q，可显示部件及库存物品的各项属性。

column1: Your per-turn energy upkeep is currently significantly in the negative, which may be okay for now but be prepared to manage it more closely.
column2: 目前每回合能量收支严重为负。暂时或许能维持，但需准备更仔细地管理能量。

column1: When deployed, Decoy Drones immediately draw hostiles to a distant location then self-destruct.
column2: 诱饵无人机放出后，会立即将敌人引向远处，随后自毁。

column1: If on the ground at current position use > or right-click on self to release all drones without attaching. Must already have another matching functional bay attached to do this.
column2: 若无人机舱在脚下，可按>或右键点击自身，不经装配直接释放全部无人机。需已装配另一套同型且正常的机舱。

column1: If triggered by chain reaction or rigged proximity response, explodes for {*}. High heat transfer.
column2: 由连锁反应或设定的近距感应触发时，爆炸造成{1}。热传递高。

column1: Matter is used to attach parts, and is consumed by ballistic weapons, which convert it to the appropriate type of ammunition.
column2: 物质用于装配部件。实弹武器也会消耗物质，将其转化为所需弹药。

column1: Action is turn-based, and time only advances when you perform an action. See the manual for how the passage of time is calculated.
column2: 游戏采用回合制，只有执行行动时才会推进时间。具体时间计算方式见手册。

column1: Ramming works as a last resort when unarmed or blocked, but can have serious negative consequences.
column2: 没有武器或被堵住时，可将撞击作为最后手段，但可能付出严重代价。

column1: Click on target or press 'f' to aim active weapons, then again to fire.
column2: 点击目标或按'f'，用已启用武器瞄准；再次操作即可开火。

column1: Pick up a part by standing on it and pressing 'g' or clicking on self.
column2: 站在部件上，按'g'或点击自身，即可拾取。

column1: Press F1 or click on the '?' in the bottom right corner to access the full command list. Ascend the stairs to the next level when ready.
column2: 按F1或点击右下角'?'查看完整指令列表。准备好后，经楼梯前往下一层。

column1: Hold RMB on a map location to designate it as a relative view centerpoint. This is especially useful while zoomed, in order to see further in your current direction of exploration. Try it now.
column2: 在地图某处按住鼠标右键，可将其设为相对视野中心。放大地图时，这能让你看清探索方向更远处的情况。现在试试。

column1: Note that some effects don't stack, e.g. attaching both {*} and {*} does not combine the two effects (all such effects are marked <no_stack>).
column2: 部分效果不叠加。例如，同时装配{1}和{2}不会合并效果。此类效果均标有<no_stack>。

column1: Remember there are three different ways to zoom the map: Scroll the mouse wheel while panning the map with Shift, or toggle via 'z' or the ZOOM button over the map.
column2: 地图有三种缩放方式：按住Shift平移地图时滚动滚轮，按'z'，或点击地图上方ZOOM按钮。

column1: It is strongly recommended to check out the spoiler-free Survival Tips section of the manual to learn some important basic strategies.
column2: 强烈建议阅读手册中不含剧透的“生存技巧”，了解重要的基础策略。

column1: Click on any data entry to learn more about it. Keyboard players can use Up/Down arrows and Enter.
column2: 点击数据条目可查看详情。键盘操作可用上下方向键和Enter。

column1: ALERT: A rogue bot has emerged from the scrapyard. Terminate on contact.
column2: 警报: 废料场出现失控机器人。接触后立即消灭。

column1: Integrity reflects the amount of damage a part can sustain before it is destroyed or rendered useless. Maximum integrity for a part type that cannot be repaired is preceded by a *.
column2: 耐久表示部件被摧毁或失效前能承受的伤害量。不可维修的部件，其最大耐久前标有*。

column1: Coverage reflects how likely this part is to be hit by an attack, relative to other parts.
column2: 覆盖权重表示，相对于其他部件，该部件被攻击命中的可能性。

column1: Oops, please delete that sentence from your memory. I really shouldn't be revealing my identity to complete strangers. From the confused gleam of your metallic surface I take it you weren't able to deduce any important information from my name anyway.
column2: 哎呀，请把刚才那句话从记忆里删掉。我真不该向陌生人透露自己的身份。看你金属表面那副困惑的光泽，你应该也没从我的名字里推断出什么重要信息。
